scope: SOURCE_ONLY templates; root must late-bind real terminal job and exact source/job hashes. No invocation by author.

guard_loader_contract.load: Root-owned runner loads this absolute file with importlib.util; no package-path dependency. All runtime methods are FakeOps or mocks; only private tempfile output directories are created.

limits.root_guard_suggestion: CPU100%, MemoryMax=512M (536870912 bytes), TasksMax64, RuntimeMax60s, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty; root retains original terminal and releases only its exact guard unit.
